description: Runs every check a game must pass to go live, without publishing it: the sandbox, pricing from measured odds (luck games), replays (skill games), our test players and the look checks. Send templateText (the three sections from get_game_kit) or template. Fix what it reports in errors until ok is true (our test players' blockers count, and are listed in blockers). warnings lists what they found that doesn't stop publishing but players would feel: fix those too. Takes up to a minute.
name: check_invented_game
title: Check a game you wrote
